1368:v1:8380c1413f88.title: Fix(cli): delete a word with Ctrl-Backspace
1368:v1:8380c1413f88.summary: The PR extends the word-delete handler in `MultilineInput` to treat Ctrl+Backspace the same as Alt+Backspace and Ctrl+W, since the previous condition only matched an Alt-like modifier. A test mounts the real component and asserts that pressing Ctrl+Backspace on 'hello world' removes 'world' and leaves the cursor at position 6. The preview shows the existing backspace branch being broadened and a new test block added to cover it.

1361:v1:ea359189e5d2.title: Turn the exit resume hint into a banner that shows the brand, the session and the command
1361:v1:ea359189e5d2.summary: The PR replaces the plain text exit resume hint in use-exit-handler.ts with a framed banner built by a new exit-banner utility imported from utils/exit-banner. The banner renders the Freebuff or Codebuff brand name, the session label, and the full resume command, and the exit handler now reads the in-progress chat directory via project-files helpers before the process tears down. A new test file pins the banner composition so the behavior survives the synchronous exit phase.

1363:v1:9cd88caa9ffc.title: Cli: restore the .scm preload so cd cli && bun test starts
1363:v1:9cd88caa9ffc.summary: This pull request proposes restoring the `.scm` text loader preload that `cli/bunfig.toml` registers so that running `cd cli && bun test` starts again. The loader reads tree-sitter query files (`*.scm`) as text via a custom Bun plugin emitting them as JS modules with a default export, and adds a new `scm-loader` test suite alongside a shared `test/setup-scm-loader.ts` helper. Without this preload, imports of these queries resolve to file paths instead of their text content, which breaks the loader's intended behavior even though the CLI can fall back to reading the paths from disk.

1357:v1:5a6cdc500d88.title: Fix CLI status bar to keep session readout separate from transient status messages
1357:v1:5a6cdc500d88.summary: The PR modifies the CLI status bar so that transient status messages like clipboard confirmations or connection indicators no longer overwrite the persistent session readout. The preview shows the status-bar test file gaining new cases that render a live FreebuffSessionResponse alongside statusMessage values and assert both the transient indicator and the session token count readout remain visible in the same row. The session readout is treated as persistent state rather than sharing the row with ephemeral indicators, so a transient message cannot blank it.

1358:v1:1a0758787c5c.title: Require two consecutive failed health checks before reporting disconnection
1358:v1:1a0758787c5c.summary: The CLI introduces a createProbeFailureTracker in use-connection-status that holds a consecutiveFailures counter and only flips the 'connecting' badge once the DISCONNECT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD of two sustained failures is met. A single recordFailure now resolves true without alarming, while an isolated blip resets the streak so transient network hiccups no longer paint a false disconnected state.

1350:v1:6189ba990787.title: Point the real terminal cursor at the caret for IME candidate windows
1350:v1:6189ba990787.summary: The PR proposes to stop drawing an ASCII caret (`▍`) in the multiline input and instead move the real terminal cursor to the caret position so that IME candidate windows anchor to the correct location. The preview shows a new test file `cli/src/components/__tests__/multiline-input-caret.test.tsx` that mounts the `MultilineInput` via `@opentui/core/testing` and asserts the terminal cursor state (`visible`, `x`, `y`) tracks the logical caret, including advancing one column per ASCII character and two columns per CJK glyph. It also asserts no `▍` glyph is rendered and that the terminal cursor is hidden when the input loses focus.

1259:v1:a4f95e6efc1f.title: Fix MCP tool schema and result handling bug families
1259:v1:a4f95e6efc1f.summary: The PR proposes seven fixes across MCP tool schema handling, result mapping, and agent state representation, including serving JSON Schema tool inputs verbatim instead of zod round-tripping, keeping zod schema instances alive when cloning tool definitions, and mapping text and non-image MCP resources to json instead of media. The preview shows that text resources now flow through mcpContentToToolResultOutputs as json values, and tool definitions are stored as plain JSON Schema in agent state. Regression tests are promoted into a permanent checklist-shaped suite covering wiring, mapping, and type correctness.

1345:v1:7bbd53afb7ff.title: Rewind the conversation on /undo, staged so a redo can lift it (part 3 of 944)
1345:v1:7bbd53afb7ff.summary: The PR proposes wiring up the final piece of the /undo flow: a staged rewind that reverts the selected snapshot and injects the result as a system message into the current chat, while keeping the redo half ready to reapply it. The preview shows new imports driving the undo/redo history store alongside the chat history store, and the handleUndoSelect/handleRedoSelect callbacks that invoke undoToRecord and redoToRecord respectively before surfacing their return values via getSystemMessage. This is the third and final part of #944.

1343:v1:823b7fa390ad.title: Add the /undo snapshot engine with anchored persistence
1343:v1:823b7fa390ad.summary: This PR introduces the /undo snapshot engine that captures file state snapshots before edits and stores them in a git-backed snapshot repository tied to each chat, using anchor, track, and release operations to manage snapshot lifecycle. The preview shows the engine is designed to survive the cleanup job's garbage collection by anchoring snapshots so they persist through the 7-day grace period, with tests verifying undo/redo stack management and snapshot pruning behavior. This is part one of the larger #944 effort to deliver reliable undo functionality to Freebuff.

1344:v1:bbc83b1e7923.title: Add the /undo and /redo picker, with the cascade warning
1344:v1:bbc83b1e7923.summary: This PR proposes a UI picker for the /undo and /redo commands, letting users select a snapshot record from a list and revert or restore it against the current project. The picker surfaces a cascade warning before applying a change and feeds the resulting message back into the active chat via getSystemMessage. The preview shows the new UndoHistoryScreen being wired into cli/src/app.tsx alongside undo-store calls to undoToRecord and redoToRecord.

1341:v1:5170098c50d1.title: Handle cyclic run-state on session resume
1341:v1:5170098c50d1.summary: The PR proposes updating `applyOverridesToSessionState` in `sdk/src/run-state.ts` to replace the plain `cloneDeep` call with `cloneDeepWith` so that self-referential structures survive the resume path. The preview shows a customizer that detects zod schema values (via `safeParse` and the non-enumerable `_zod` handle) and preserves them intact, preventing the "JSON.stringify cannot serialize cyclic structures" failure that previously crashed resumed sessions.

1342:v1:b0ddd0c8d858.title: Fix agent-runtime keep zod internals when copying tool definitions
1342:v1:b0ddd0c8d858.summary: When building the tool set, the code deep-clones each tool definition with lodash's cloneDeep, which drops Zod's non-enumerable _zod and leaves cloned MCP tool schemas that throw on validation calls. The change carries the inputSchema reference instead of deep-cloning it, and a new test in prompts-schema-handling verifies that safeParse still works after copying. The preview shows the fix targets getToolSet in packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts.

1328:v1:bb5bc6f65cae.title: Reload MCP servers and skills after project change in picker
1328:v1:bb5bc6f65cae.summary: This PR addresses an issue where changing projects via the project picker in the CLI doesn't refresh the loaded MCP servers and skills, leaving stale registries from the previous project. It introduces reinitialization of the local agent registry and skill registry after a project change, ensuring that project-specific configurations like `.agents/mcp.json` and `.agents/skills/` are correctly loaded. The change includes an integration test that reproduces the bug by switching from a project without `.agents/` to one with MCP and skill definitions, validating that registries are reloaded properly.

1316:v1:177b758901fb.title: Stop CLI launcher re-downloading installed binary on every launch
1316:v1:177b758901fb.summary: The launcher in cli/release-core/launcher.js now consults a new getUpdateComparisonVersion() helper that falls back to the wrapper version when the metadata cache is missing or unreadable, so an already-installed binary that still exists on disk is no longer treated as unknown and re-downloaded on every startup. The registry URL is also made overridable via CODEBUFF_NPM_REGISTRY_URL so tests can intercept the version check instead of hitting the real npm registry. A new test suite cli/src/__tests__/release/launcher-installed-binary.test.ts covers these startup and background-update scenarios.

1308:v1:555f9dcd16e0.title: Fix stuck model switches from false end-failure in session takeover
1308:v1:555f9dcd16e0.summary: This PR refactors the model_locked takeover flow in `cli/src/hooks/use-freebuff-session.ts` so the deliberate-pick guard, follow-up GET, DELETE, and chat notices all live in `runModelLockedTakeover` with injected collaborators, and the new `planModelLockedSwitch` planner maps the follow-up GET row to `release`, `retry`, or `explain` outcomes. It fixes two false end-failure cases that stranded users for an hour: `ended` rows still inside the server grace window now trigger a release instead of reporting 'ending it failed, run /end-session', and rows that vanished between the lock response and follow-up GET fall through to `retry` without surfacing the missing-row notice. The preview shows a new test file `model-locked-takeover.test.ts` covering active, ended-in-grace, vanished, and ended-past-grace held-row shapes with injected `fetchHeld`/`releaseSlot`/`notify`/`isStale` collaborators.

1311:v1:429057371aae.title: Throw error for invalid currency conversion inputs with tests
1311:v1:429057371aae.summary: This PR modifies the currency conversion functions in `common/src/util/currency.ts` to throw explicit errors instead of silently returning 0 when invalid inputs are detected. Previously, non-positive `centsPerCredit` values and NaN or Infinity inputs for `credits` or `amountInCents` would result in incorrect conversions without any indication of failure. The preview shows both functions now validate inputs and throw descriptive error messages, such as `convertCreditsToUsdCents: centsPerCredit must be positive, got ${centsPerCredit}`.

1302:v1:b9eff978cd65.title: Enhance tests for axiom response assertion
1302:v1:b9eff978cd65.summary: The PR expands test coverage for the Axiom response assertion helper by adding cases for non-throwing complete responses, statusless and partial inputs with an end-anchored regex, and non-object inputs. It addresses three gaps flagged in the description: missing coverage for the complete (non-partial) case, missing statusless input cases, and an unanchored toThrow regex. The preview shows changes confined to common/src/util/__tests__/axiom-complete-response.test.ts.

1303:v1:2b150bb856fe.title: Add cache-aware chat history compression and compaction
1303:v1:2b150bb856fe.summary: The PR proposes a new chat-compression utility in cli/src/utils/chat-compression.ts that compacts message history when conversations approach the model's token budget, replacing a contiguous middle slice with a structured synthetic summary to preserve conversational invariants. The preview shows interfaces for ChatMessage, CompactionMeta, UsageSnapshot, and CompressionOptions, including a Summarizer callback and cache-aware gating that skips compression while the provider is prefilling below a configurable fresh-input ratio. Commits refactor the file for clarity and expand inline comments, and the change currently carries pr:needs-work and bot:triaged labels.

1292:v1:85e3657e2267.title: Drop orphaned tool results at trim boundary
1292:v1:85e3657e2267.summary: The PR adds a post-trim sweep in `trimMessagesToFitTokenLimit` that removes surviving `role: 'tool'` messages whose `toolCallId` no longer appears in any retained assistant tool-call, closing the gap left by `dropUnansweredToolCalls`. The preview shows new regression tests in `messages.test.ts` covering boundary orphaning, the `keepDuringTruncation` middle case, and a keep-survival guard.

1291:v1:f4522bbee589.title: Guard whitespace-only strings from empty-match file corruption
1291:v1:f4522bbee589.summary: The PR adds a guard in `packages/agent-runtime/src/process-str-replace.ts` so that when the whitespace-insensitive fallback in `tryMatchOldStr` strips a whitespace-only `oldString` to `''`, it reports not-found instead of producing a vacuous empty match. Without this fix, `replaceAll('', newStr)` inserted the new string between every character of the file and the tool returned success with the corrupted content written to disk.

1289:v1:01868972dee3.title: Add /skills panel: browse, invoke, open, and delete loaded skills
1289:v1:01868972dee3.summary: The PR proposes a new /skills (alias /skill) slash command that opens an interactive panel mirroring the existing queue-panel architecture for managing loaded skills, which currently have no in-CLI management surface. The panel lets users run skills via Enter (sharing the same enterSkillMode path as /skill:<name>), open each skill's SKILL.md in $EDITOR with o, delete with d (after an explicit confirmation showing the file path), and fall back to install guidance when no skills are loaded. The implementation introduces state/skills-panel-store.ts as a zustand store paralleling queue-panel-store and utils/skills-panel-actions.ts as a keymap resolver and renderer-free logic layer, while chat.tsx now subscribes to the skill registry version via useSyncExternalStore so mid-session changes like delete or on-disk edits swap the list without a restart.

1286:v1:2c5dd67ff28f.title: Add missing test setup for scm loader imports
1286:v1:2c5dd67ff28f.summary: The PR adds a bun plugin that loads .scm tree-sitter query files as default-exported strings, fixing a missing preload referenced in cli/bunfig.toml that causes @codebuff/sdk imports to fail at import time with 'Unknown file type' errors. The change adds the test/setup-scm-loader.ts loader and a regression test in cli/src/__tests__/scm-loader.test.ts.

1284:v1:f3da456b874b.title: Fix NaN handling in ttft latency bucket index
1284:v1:f3da456b874b.summary: The `ttftBucketIndex` function in `common/src/util/ttft-histogram.ts` does not validate that the latency input is a finite number, so a `NaN` input propagates through `Math.max` and `Math.log` to produce a `NaN` bucket index. The preview shows the fix special-casing only `Number.isNaN` to route to bucket 0, while letting `Infinity` values flow through the normal calculation where they clamp to the top bucket.

1274:v1:f70b1a2c23c1.title: Feat(cli): scroll the transcript three lines per wheel notch
1274:v1:f70b1a2c23c1.summary: The PR proposes adding a stateless `ConstantScrollAccel` class to the Freebuff CLI so that a single mouse wheel notch scrolls the chat transcript by three lines instead of the default one line. It passes this accelerator through a new `scrollAcceleration` prop on the `<scrollbox>` in `chat.tsx`, which OpenTUI's `ScrollBoxRenderable` already supports via a setter and constructor. The change adds an integration test that drives real wheel events at a rendered scrollbox to verify the full OpenTUI event chain moves exactly three lines per notch.

1185:v1:58ddd876b950.title: Fix(common): use product-specific commit attribution
1185:v1:58ddd876b950.summary: Derive git commit attribution from the compile-time FREEBUFF_MODE flag in common/src/tools/params/tool/run-terminal-command.ts so Freebuff binaries emit Freebuff branding and domain while standard builds keep the existing Codebuff footer. The buildGitCommitGuidePrompt and new getGitCommitGuidePrompt helpers select product name and domain via getCommitAttribution, and a new run-terminal-command-branding.test.ts covers both variants. The preview shows the test file and refactored run-terminal-command.ts, with the FREEBUFF_MODE check and CommitAttribution type introduced around line 71.

1258:v1:5400107fb79b.title: Wait for current turn to finish before auto-update restart
1258:v1:5400107fb79b.summary: PR #1258 proposes a fix for issue #994 where the CLI wrapper unconditionally stops the running process during an auto-update, even if the user is mid-turn. The patch adds a cross-process activity marker written by the binary side via `cli/src/utils/run-activity-marker.ts` for the duration of a turn, and a corresponding `waitForRunIdle(pid)` polling function in `cli/release-core/launcher.js` that waits for the marker to clear before stopping the process. The preview shows `waitForRunIdle` being called in the launcher's update flow after staging the binary and before stopping the running process, with a bounded 10-minute wait and stale marker cleanup on spawn.

1256:v1:29b9b2c86b2a.title: Queue plan, interview, and review mid-turn submits instead of interrupting in-progress runs
1256:v1:29b9b2c86b2a.summary: The /plan, /interview, and /review slash commands currently bypass the busy-state check that other mid-turn submit paths use, calling sendMessage() directly and forcing registerActiveRun to abort an in-flight run. The fix routes these commands through the same isStreaming || streamMessageIdRef.current || isChainInProgressRef.current guard and falls back to addToQueue() when the agent is busy. The diff preview shows the accompanying test coverage in router-steering.test.ts asserting queued delivery for both input-mode submits and inline-arg invocations.

1266:v1:d58677e04a13.title: Strip all ANSI control sequences in bounded terminal output buffer
1266:v1:d58677e04a13.summary: The PR switches BoundedOutputBuffer.append from stripColors to stripAnsi in sdk/src/tools/run-terminal-command.ts and updates INCOMPLETE_ESCAPE_SEQUENCE_REGEX to match split ECMA-48 CSI and OSC sequences across chunk boundaries, tightening OSC handling so terminated sequences are not buffered. It also reorders ansiRegex in common/src/util/string.ts to prioritize CSI and OSC sequences over generic Fe escapes and supports both BEL and ST terminators, renaming pendingColorSequence to pendingEscapeSequence. Unit tests are added in sdk and common covering line clears, cursor movement, OSC terminators, and chunk-split escape sequences.

1368:v2:8380c1413f88.title: Fix(cli): delete a word with Ctrl+Backspace
1368:v2:8380c1413f88.summary: The PR updates the multiline input handler in `cli/src/components/multiline-input.tsx` to treat Ctrl+Backspace as a word-delete shortcut alongside the existing Alt+Backspace and Ctrl+W bindings, matching common terminal editing expectations. It also adds a test in `cli/src/components/__tests__/multiline-input.test.tsx` that mounts the component and verifies pressing Ctrl+Backspace on `hello world` removes the trailing word, leaving `hello ` with the cursor at position 6.

1346:v2:f90c9a472d66.title: Add -c/--continue alias and nothing to continue notice
1346:v2:f90c9a472d66.summary: The CLI adds a short -c alias alongside the existing --continue flag for resuming sessions, parsed in parseArgs and threaded through app.tsx as continueRequested. When the probe finds no active session with status 'none', the landing screen renders a FreebuffNothingToContinueNotice explaining there's nothing to continue. Tests in cli-args.test.ts and freebuff-nothing-to-continue.test.tsx pin the parsing behavior and the status-gated notice invariant.

1381:v2:8a3740a4315d.title: Throw errors for invalid currency conversion inputs
1381:v2:8a3740a4315d.summary: The PR adds input validation to `convertCreditsToUsdCents` and `convertStripeGrantAmountToCredits` in `common/src/util/currency.ts`, throwing errors when `centsPerCredit` is not a positive finite number or when `credits`/`amountInCents` is non-finite like `NaN` or `Infinity`. It also introduces a new test file `common/src/util/__tests__/currency.test.ts` covering valid conversions, rounding behavior, and the new validation cases. The changes harden the currency utility logic against invalid numeric inputs that could otherwise propagate silently through the Freebucks spend ceiling and Stripe grant pathways.

1365:v2:f64ad08b8440.title: Surface broker protocol write failures via stderr in CLI
1365:v2:f64ad08b8440.summary: The terminal command broker now writes a `[freebuff-broker] protocol write failed:` marker to stderr before reaping its process group when writing the response file fails, and the parent classifies the combined stderr into the new `protocol_write_failed` failure code. Protocol path validation is also tightened to resolve symlinks and compare the temp directory case-insensitively on Windows, with ENOENT retries on the parent side so a racy write is no longer misreported as a missing response.

1372:v2:08c03a688174.title: Add agent plugin install and discovery (Agent Plugins spec v1.0.0)
1372:v2:08c03a688174.summary: The PR adds a `freebuff plugin install <url>` command that fetches a GitHub tarball, validates its manifest against the 1.0.0 schema, and writes the plugin under the plugins root (`FREEBUFF_PLUGINS_ROOT` or `~/.agents/plugins`). It also wires discovered plugin skills and MCP servers into the session registries via new `plugin-discovery` helpers, with name-conflict checks against the user's existing roots.

1377:v2:97a2bac65d55.title: Guard CPU info lookup against os.cpus() failure
1377:v2:97a2bac65d55.summary: This PR wraps the systeminformation.cpu() call in getCpuInfoSafe(), which probes os.cpus() first and returns empty CPU fingerprint values when it throws on ARM Linux with CPU hotplug skew, preventing a crash. The change targets cli/src/utils/fingerprint.ts where the previous call could throw synchronously and bypass the try/catch.

1357:v2:f1c958605622.title: Keep session readout in its own lane so transient status cannot blank it
1357:v2:f1c958605622.summary: The status bar now renders the persistent session readout (model name, remaining time, context usage) in its own layout lane instead of inside the 'idle' branch of the transient status indicator. This keeps the session readout visible even when a transient status message, a clipboard confirmation, a 'connecting...' indicator, or an ask_user pause blanks or short-circuits the transient lane. The new tests cover BYOK, Freebuff session, and remainingMs-urgent color paths that were removed from renderStatusIndicator.

1350:v2:2495b829d12b.title: Point the real terminal cursor at the caret so IME candidate windows land in the input
1350:v2:2495b829d12b.summary: The PR removes the component-drawn `▍` caret from `MultilineInput` and instead moves the terminal's real cursor to the caret cell each frame via a new `ime-caret` utility, so IME candidate windows on Windows, macOS, and Linux anchor to the correct position. It replaces the `InputCursor` React component with `renderer.setCursorPosition` calls driven by `textBufferView.lineInfo.lineStartCols`, adds `useClipboard` cleanup now that there is no cursor glyph to strip, and adds tests for CJK two-cell width, tab expansion, and scrolled-out-of-view hiding.

1259:v2:6e049813395f.title: Fix MCP tool schema and result handling bugs
1259:v2:6e049813395f.summary: The PR overhauls how MCP tool schemas and results are stored and mapped, fixing sessions that died from cyclic Zod instances in serialized state and tool results that poisoned prompt builds. It extracts content mapping into a dedicated module, stores schemas verbatim as plain JSON Schema, and repairs schema-guided decoding of string-encoded union parameters. New regression tests cover text/image/non-image resource mapping, loose MCP schema survival, zod-safe cloning, and non-image file part degradation.

1343:v2:266e085c0ce0.title: Add the /undo snapshot engine, anchored so it survives cleanup (part 1 of 944)
1343:v2:266e085c0ce0.summary: This PR adds a new per-chat undo/redo journal that captures filesystem snapshots before each assistant turn using a dedicated hidden git repository per project, keeping the snapshot repo separate from the user's real .git. The journal writes undo.json inside each chat's data directory and anchors snapshots with refs so the cleanup job's gc does not collect them prematurely, and provides /undo and /redo commands that revert or restore the affected files.

1358:v2:186b1b1fe123.title: Wait for two consecutive health-check failures before reporting a disconnection
1358:v2:186b1b1fe123.summary: Instead of flipping the CLI badge to disconnected on the first failed probe, `useConnectionStatus` now routes failures through a `createProbeFailureTracker` that only calls `setIsConnected(false)` once `consecutiveFailures` reaches `DISCONNECT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD` (default 2). A single `recordFailure()` returns false, so transient blips no longer paint a false disconnected state while backoff still uses the accumulated streak, and one `recordSuccess()` resets the count so recovery feels instant. The new disconnect hysteresis tests assert isolated single blips, sustained streaks, and a threshold one override for the old notify-on-first-failure behavior.

1345:v2:0adb23507f7c.title: Rewind the conversation on /undo, staged so a redo can lift it
1345:v2:0adb23507f7c.summary: This PR completes part 3 of the multi-step /undo and /redo implementation by adding the conversation-rewind path to `undoToRecord` so an undo reverts not only files but also the model's memory of the turn, staging a `RewindBoundary` in `undo.json` that a `/redo` lifts. The picker surfaces the staged cut's blast radius (how many newer changes are also affected) before the user commits, and `applyRewind` slice-copies `messageHistory` on its way into `createRunConfig` rather than mutating the in-memory state the run persists. New `CommandResultBlock` styling and a red/green color accent distinguish undo and redo confirmations from plain agent output, and a full batch of unit tests covers the guards, rewind helpers, snapshot anchoring, and the journal round trips.

1361:v2:edfab94528db.title: Turn the exit resume hint into a banner that shows the brand, the session and the command
1361:v2:edfab94528db.summary: This PR replaces the plain text exit message with a framed ASCII banner that displays the Freebuff/Codebuff brand mark, a session label derived from the chat metadata, and the full resume command. It introduces a pure banner-composition function in exit-banner.ts, an exit-session gate that suppresses the hint for empty chats, and tests covering color support, clipping, and wordmark rendering. The banner degrades gracefully on narrow terminals and never clips the underlying --continue command.

1363:v2:9cd88caa9ffc.title: Restore .scm preload for cli bun test
1363:v2:9cd88caa9ffc.summary: The PR adds a bun plugin preload that handles `*.scm` tree-sitter query files by emitting their text content as a JS module with a default export. It also adds tests that verify the loader correctly escapes and round-trips query text including backslashes, quotes, and newlines. This restores the ability to run `cd cli && bun test` by ensuring the query files are loaded as text rather than paths.

1344:v2:f4492c56799b.title: Add the /undo and /redo picker, with the cascade warning
1344:v2:f4492c56799b.summary: This PR introduces the `/undo` and `/redo` picker UI component, the `UndoHistoryScreen`, which lets users select a specific recorded turn to revert or restore against their project. It implements the snapshot engine from part 1 to capture filesystem states before and after assistant turns in a dedicated hidden git repository per project, with anchoring and pruning to bound the store. The picker surfaces a cascade warning indicating how many newer turns an undo would also revert, and confirmation messages render with distinct amber/red coloring via a new `CommandResultBlock`.

1342:v2:b0ddd0c8d858.title: Keep Zod internals when copying tool definitions
1342:v2:b0ddd0c8d858.summary: The agent-runtime getToolSet function uses lodash cloneDeep to copy MCP tool definitions, but since Zod stores its internals on a non-enumerable `_zod` property, the cloned schema loses those internals and throws on subsequent Zod validation calls. The fix destructures the inputSchema from the tool definition before cloning and passes the original schema reference through, preserving Zod's internal state, with a test added in prompts-schema-handling.test.ts verifying the schema remains usable after copying.

1328:v2:c7628c5f8192.title: Reload MCP servers and skills after project change in picker
1328:v2:c7628c5f8192.summary: This PR updates the CLI so that when a developer switches projects through the project picker, the agent/MCP and skill registries are reinitialized for the newly selected project directory. Previously, `initializeAgentRegistry` and `initializeSkillRegistry` were not called after `setProjectRoot`, leaving cached local agents, MCP servers, and skills stale from the previous project and causing features like custom skills and MCP-based tools to fail to load. The fix clears the cached agent mode map and agents directory before reloading definitions, and adds an integration test reproducing the original bug and verifying correct reloads across project switches.

1340:v2:a172f7152fac.title: Pin locale in sponsored guard test helper spawn
1340:v2:a172f7152fac.summary: The test in `sponsored-rooted-filesystem.test.ts` spawns a subprocess that triggers a coreutils guard failure, whose message text is locale-dependent. The PR pins `LC_ALL: 'C'` on the helper subprocess environment so assertions on the failure message hold across English and translated CI runners.

1308:v2:4c5239224ebf.title: Fix stuck model switches from false end-failure in session takeover
1308:v2:4c5239224ebf.summary: PR #1308 refactors the model_locked takeover path into runModelLockedTakeover with a new planModelLockedSwitch helper that distinguishes a real release from a lock that already released itself, so the "ending it failed" notice only fires after a genuine delete was attempted. 1217:v2:09876e06a681.title: Eliminate redundant stat calls and queue shifts in file tree crawl
1217:v2:09876e06a681.summary: This PR reorders the directory traversal in `project-file-tree.ts` so that `fs.readdir` runs before `parseGitignore`, calling `parseGitignore` only when an ignore file appears in the returned entries. It also swaps `queue.shift()!` for an index pointer to avoid quadratic array reallocations and passes existing directory entries into `parseGitignoreWithMode` to skip unnecessary stat calls.

1219:v2:49438e90c74a.title: Optimize think tag parser with early-exit and cursor indexing
1219:v2:49438e90c74a.summary: The PR refactors the think-tag detection logic in `cli/src/utils/think-tag-parser.ts` to replace sequential prefix array checks with an early-exit `lastIndexOf` approach and switches `parseThinkTags` from repeated string slicing to index cursor traversal, reducing allocations. The unused `PARTIAL_OPEN_PREFIXES` and `PARTIAL_CLOSE_PREFIXES` arrays are removed, and all 22 existing unit tests pass with identical behavior.

1218:v2:580edcff23fc.title: Conditionally compute visual line layout in Thinking component
1218:v2:580edcff23fc.summary: In `cli/src/components/thinking.tsx`, the `getLastNVisualLines` wrapping computation now runs only when `thinkingCollapseState` is `'preview'`, skipping the expensive measure-and-wrap pass for both `'hidden'` and `'expanded'` states. In `cli/src/components/blocks/thinking-block.tsx`, a fast-path avoids allocating intermediate `.map()` arrays when `blocks.length === 1` during streaming updates. The PR adds unit tests covering all three collapse states and reports 5x speedups on hidden state and 4.3x on expanded state in end-to-end React render benchmarks.

1215:v2:5b5ebb50e8b6.title: Optimize value extraction with early guard and streaming scan
1215:v2:5b5ebb50e8b6.summary: This PR refactors the value extraction helper in the CLI utilities to avoid allocating a full array of lines on every call by replacing the split operation with an index-based line scanner that walks the output incrementally. An instant substring guard checks for the presence of the searched key before any parsing begins, and keys located near the start of the output now return immediately without scanning the remainder. Benchmarks show lookups for missing keys in a 5,000-line output dropping from 11.02ms down to 0.20ms (55x speedup), and finding a key on line 1 dropping from 17.41ms down to 0.31ms (56x speedup across 100 runs).

1212:v2:8ce7a100f5d7.title: Support Windows paths and directory separators in path tab completion
1212:v2:8ce7a100f5d7.summary: The PR refactors path tab completion in the CLI to recognize Windows drive paths (C:\...) and UNC paths as absolute by exporting an isAbsolutePath helper that checks both POSIX and Windows path styles. It also exports isCompleteDirectory to detect trailing backslashes appended by path-completion.ts, and toRelativePath to convert absolute completions back to relative display paths, restoring automatic directory navigation on Windows.

1209:v2:be9f260782c4.title: Prevent negative slice indices in string truncation
1209:v2:be9f260782c4.summary: The `truncateStringWithMessage` function in `common/src/util/string.ts` gains `Math.max(0, ...)` guards to prevent negative slice indices when `maxLength` is smaller than the message, prefix, or suffix length. The fix applies to all three truncation modes: `END`, `START`, and `MIDDLE`, ensuring the output is properly bounded rather than silently returning an unintended chunk of the original string. Nine new test cases in `common/src/util/__tests__/string.test.ts` cover normal truncation, edge cases with negative/zero available length, and custom message handling.

1208:v2:b302df72779e.title: Auto-save launched project to recent projects and canonicalize paths
1208:v2:b302df72779e.summary: This PR proposes automatically recording a launched project into recent-projects.json during CLI boot in cli/src/index.tsx whenever Freebuff starts directly inside a project rather than showing the project picker, filling the gap left by saveRecentProject previously being called only on project-picker selection. It canonicalizes projectPath with path.resolve() in saveRecentProject and removeRecentProject within cli/src/utils/recent-projects.ts to prevent duplicate entries and filtering mismatches from relative paths or trailing slashes, and switches the import of getConfigDir from ./auth to ./config-dir to avoid loading the full auth/api stack. New tests in cli/src/__tests__/utils/recent-projects.test.ts cover path canonicalization, disk-validation filtering, LRU-style capping at MAX_RECENT_PROJECTS, project removal, and clearing behavior.

1206:v2:e139a3509eac.title: Support quoted image paths and preserve prompt in CLI image command
1206:v2:e139a3509eac.summary: This PR refactors the `/image <path> [message]` command parsing to correctly handle quoted paths (`"..."` and `'...'`) and backslash-escaped spaces by extracting the logic into a standalone pure utility `parseImageCommandArgs`. Previously, naive whitespace splitting corrupted filenames containing spaces and discarded the accompanying user message. The parser now preserves the attached image alongside the extracted prompt message so it remains visible in the input field.

1207:v2:f9ae54004122.title: Direct launcher crash reports to product issues tracker
1207:v2:f9ae54004122.summary: The PR updates `printCrashDiagnostics` in `cli/release-core/launcher.js` to build the crash report issue tracker URL from the `packageName` configuration value rather than hardcoding `CodebuffAI/codebuff`. A new regression test in `cli/src/__tests__/release/wrapper-safety.test.ts` verifies that crash diagnostics emit the product-specific GitHub issues URL for both `freebuff` and `codebuff` launchers.

1202:v2:b0163bb8f148.title: Fix dead agents-graveyard test imports in agent-runtime
1202:v2:b0163bb8f148.summary: This PR fixes two TypeScript compilation errors in the agent-runtime package caused by imports from the archived agents-graveyard directory. It replaces the dead imports in read-docs-tool.test.ts and web-search-tool.test.ts with active public definitions from agents/researcher/researcher-docs.ts and agents/researcher/researcher-web.ts respectively. The fix ensures typetests pass and both test suites no longer crash during import.

1205:v2:ff6788369871.title: Support Freebuff binary and environment variable in tmux test helper
1205:v2:ff6788369871.summary: The PR updates `scripts/tmux/tmux-start.sh` to detect the compiled Freebuff binary (`cli/bin/freebuff`) in addition to Codebuff, using a fallback chain that prefers Freebuff when present. It also introduces `FREEBUFF_BINARY` as an environment variable override alongside `CODEBUFF_BINARY`, and updates the missing-binary guidance message to reference `bun run build:freebuff`.

1201:v2:925150efc2d0.title: Fix Zod v4 schema description crash in agent-runtime
1201:v2:925150efc2d0.summary: This PR guards the `schema.description` getter access inside `ensureJsonSchemaCompatible()` in both `packages/agent-runtime/src/tools/prompts.ts` and `packages/agent-runtime/src/templates/prompts.ts` within a nested try/catch block. Under Zod v4, accessing `.description` on non-serializable schemas like `z.function()` throws a `TypeError` due to `schema._zod.parent` being undefined, which previously crashed `getToolSet` and failed unit tests. The fix ensures these schemas return the passthrough fallback object cleanly without throwing.

1204:v2:0a6670cf3e25.title: Fix Pino type imports and destination in evals logger
1204:v2:0a6670cf3e25.summary: The PR updates `evals/logger.ts` to import `pino` as the default export and `LogFn` as a top-level type from `pino`, resolving three `tsc` typechecking errors that occurred because Pino v9 moved `pino.destination` onto the default export and exposed `LogFn` as a named type. The `logger` object's type annotation is changed from `Record<LogLevel, pino.LogFn>` to `Record<LogLevel, LogFn>` in both the declaration and the final cast, aligning with Pino v9's exports. This change enables a clean `bun run --cwd evals typecheck` with zero errors.

1203:v2:1fae6417267d.title: Fix CLI test runner preload and test-utils fallback for public mirror
1203:v2:1fae6417267d.summary: The PR removes the non-existent ../test/setup-scm-loader.ts entry from cli/bunfig.toml preload, which prevented bun test from starting in cli due to a missing file after the root test directory was unbundled from the public mirror. It also wraps the dynamic require for packages/internal/src/env in a try/catch that falls back to TEST_CLIENT_ENV_DEFAULTS and TEST_SERVER_ENV_DEFAULTS when the private internal module is unavailable in the public repo, allowing ensureCliTestEnv to initialize without crashing. These changes unblock CLI testing on the public mirror where private modules are not included.

1198:v2:d58ff5f2e291.title: Sdk: use max instead of sum for OpenRouter cost fields
1198:v2:d58ff5f2e291.summary: The SDK currently sums usage.cost and cost_details.upstream_inference_cost across all three prompt paths to derive the billed credit amount, which double-charges non-BYOK OpenRouter routes where upstream_inference_cost is already included in the total cost. The PR replaces the addition with Math.max, so normal routes pick the authoritative total and BYOK routes (where cost is 0) pick the upstream value, matching the server-side extractUsageAndCost semantics in freebuff-models.ts. The strengthened test now asserts the exact expected credit value rather than just greater-than zero.

1199:v2:cb007c00b544.title: Stop run after local prompt config errors
1199:v2:cb007c00b544.summary: When assembleLocalAgentTemplates returns validation errors, callMainPrompt now returns early with an error result and a prompt-response action, instead of continuing into mainPrompt. Before this change, the orphaned run would keep executing after the prompt-error banner, burning credits, executing tools, and mutating shared state while the UI already showed the error. A new regression test in call-main-prompt.test.ts verifies the early return behavior.

1195:v2:83f7d1c575b5.title: Recover agent context from torn run-state.json backups
1195:v2:83f7d1c575b5.summary: When `run-state.json` is unreadable, `loadMostRecentChatState` now recovers from the rotated `.bak` or leftover checkpoint `.tmp` files, ordered newest-first by mtime with path-based tiebreaks for deterministic selection. `loadMostRecentChatState` returns a `runStateRestored` flag so the resume flow surfaces the loss instead of silently answering amnesiacally, and `clearChatState` now also removes the `.bak` so deleting a chat leaves no recoverable state behind. Tests cover primary-to-.bak recovery, newest-.tmp preference, healthy primary passthrough, and the context-less fallback.

1192:v2:fb241ef5ffce.title: Fix blank-session restarts after interrupt or failed run
1192:v2:fb241ef5ffce.summary: The abort listener syncs the latest SDK snapshot into `previousRunStateRef` and `setRunState` synchronously via a new `onAbort` checkpoint before releasing the input lock, so an Esc-interrupted or failed run resumes from fresh state instead of stale or null continuation state. A per-run generation guard (`runGenerationRef`/`runIsCurrent`) prevents superseded runs from adopting state, persisting checkpoints, or touching shared queue state, while `loadMostRecentChatState` now refuses sessionState-less run states to avoid feeding the SDK a shell that would build a blank session. Hook-level regression tests assert the checkpoint timing, throwing-onAbort cleanup, and full-history preservation through the real `createRunConfig`/`client.run` wiring via a test-only client factory override.

1194:v2:97d57319356b.title: Fix critical bugs in string truncation and context window lookup
1194:v2:97d57319356b.summary: This PR fixes two critical bugs. In `agents/base-chat.ts`, the context window lookup is changed from `CONTEXT_WINDOWS[model ?? '']` to `(model && CONTEXT_WINDOWS[model]) ?? DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW`, avoiding an unnecessary lookup when `model` is undefined. In `common/src/util/string.ts`, `truncateStringWithMessage` is updated to use `Math.max(0, ...)` guards for `maxLength` minus `suffix.length`, `maxLength` minus `prefix.length`, and `Math.floor((maxLength - middle.length) / 2)`, preventing negative slice indices when `maxLength` is smaller than the message length.

1191:v2:51a6bad38c6c.title: Add tests and type safety for array utilities
1191:v2:51a6bad38c6c.summary: The PR introduces a new test file `common/src/util/array.test.ts` with 28 tests covering `filterDefined`, `buildArray`, and `groupConsecutive`, and fixes a loose `any[]` return type in `groupConsecutive` by adding a `Group` type definition in `common/src/util/array.ts`, improving type safety for consumers.

1171:v2:bb052cce4300.title: Bind free sessions to accounts to prevent multi-account abuse
1171:v2:bb052cce4300.summary: When a Freebuff session becomes active, the CLI now records the authenticated user's ID in an in-memory store and persists it to disk so the binding survives restarts. A startup guard ends any session whose binding does not match the current credentials, login is rejected when the bound user differs from the newly authenticated user, and /logout is blocked until /end-session or /logout --force is used, while a new ACCOUNT_SWITCH_BLOCKED analytics event tracks these blocks.

1170:v2:bfe68636735f.title: Break 3-file import cycle in cli/project-files
1170:v2:bfe68636735f.summary: The PR redirects the import of `getConfigDir` from `auth.ts` to `config-dir.ts` in `project-files.ts`, breaking a circular chain where `project-files.ts` depended on `auth.ts`, which imported `logger.ts`, which then re-imported back into `project-files.ts`. Since `auth.ts` merely re-exports the same `getConfigDir` from `config-dir.ts`, the swap preserves identical behavior while removing the runtime risk of `undefined` values at module load time, and adds two tests in `project-files-chat-id.test.ts` to assert `getProjectDataDir` resolves via the direct path.

1181:v2:8675d7d5c54f.title: Fix(core): preserve session state on abort and error
1181:v2:8675d7d5c54f.summary: The PR addresses a bug where user interruptions (Esc) or session expiration/reset the previousRunStateRef before the SDK settles, causing follow-up messages to read a stale or null state and construct an empty session. It introduces a unified syncRunState closure in use-send-message.ts used across the abort, completion, and error handlers to keep the in-memory run state fresh, and adds regression tests in use-send-message.test.tsx covering the abort, error, and no-snapshot-yet paths. The change is scoped to three files with no prompt text modifications.

1172:v2:0bf19f6e480f.title: Add code review checklist skill for code review guidance
1172:v2:0bf19f6e480f.summary: This PR proposes adding a new code-review-checklist skill under the initial agents directory, providing Freebuff-specific review guidance based on actual repo conventions and known pitfalls. The checklist covers session lifecycle, auth flow, testing conventions, and files prone to breaking changes.

1169:v2:2d8235f6dbdc.title: Fsync atomic writes before rename and retry Windows rename locks
1169:v2:2d8235f6dbdc.summary: The `writeFileAtomic` and `writeFileAtomicAsync` helpers in `cli/src/utils/write-file-atomic.ts` now fsync the temp file descriptor before renaming so a power loss cannot expose a torn `run-state.json`, with EINVAL filesystems degrading gracefully to the rename-only guarantee, and the async path gains a bounded `renameWithRetry` that retries 5 attempts with exponential backoff on Windows EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES transient handle-release races while rethrowing non-matching errors immediately. New tests verify the fsync-before-rename ordering and the retry/rethrow behavior, and the changes are confined to the durability layer as the recovery/rotation machinery landed separately.

1173:v2:3e64460b090c.title: Release an unclosed think-tag open as text at flush
1173:v2:3e64460b090c.summary: An explicit think-tag open that never closes no longer commits the entire step to the thinking box; resolution is now armed from conversation history via the new `historyHasUnclosedOpen` helper, symmetric with the existing implicit-head machinery. On a clean lane where the last assistant turn never left an open unclosed, paired blocks still stream live per-delta with zero buffering, while on a proven lane that leaves opens unclosed, `holdExplicitOpens` holds from the open until a close, the shared `IMPLICIT_OPEN_BUDGET_CHARS`, or flush releases it as text.

1187:v2:d6a784f809ca.title: Fix(common): honor DeepSeek Beijing weekend boundaries
1187:v2:d6a784f809ca.summary: The PR exports `isBeijingWeekend` and adds a `DEEPSEEK_WEEKEND_OFFPEAK_EFFECTIVE_AT_UTC` constant so the DeepSeek weekend off-peak rule only activates from 2026-08-22T16:00:00Z onward, preventing historical pricing checks from retroactively treating pre-change weekends as off-peak. The weekend eligibility logic in `deepseekPricingWindow` and `isDeepSeekExpensiveWindow` is refactored to call a new `isWeekendOffPeakEligible` helper that combines the effective-instant guard with the Beijing weekend check. New boundary tests pin the Friday 16:00Z and Sunday 16:00Z instants where UTC and Beijing calendars diverge, fixing cases the original suite missed.

1190:v2:41cc23236f81.title: Fix(cli): declare release and DOM test dependencies
1190:v2:41cc23236f81.summary: The PR adds `tar` and `@types/react-dom` as devDependencies to the CLI workspace so the release launcher, wrapper safety tests, and server-rendering component tests typecheck and resolve correctly. It regenerates `bun.lock` using the current repository's Bun version, keeping the lockfile scoped to exactly two files with minimal package-manifest and dependency-graph changes. Incompatible older transitive consumers like `tar-fs/chownr@1.1.4` and `lru-cache/yallist@4.0.0` are preserved as nested entries rather than getting upgraded transitively.

1189:v2:20ef87228a97.title: Add a non-interrupting /btw command to the CLI
1189:v2:20ef87228a97.summary: The PR adds a /btw slash command that sends an additional thought without interrupting an active turn, reusing the existing queue while preserving pending attachments. When the CLI is idle it sends the note directly and shows usage text for an empty /btw invocation. Slash-command metadata, a buildBtwPrompt helper, and regression tests covering focus and history handoff are included.

1186:v2:bc3cd31f288f.title: Fix(cli): survive unavailable chat log directory
1186:v2:bc3cd31f288f.summary: The CLI now resolves its log destination through a new `resolveLogTarget` helper wrapped in a try/catch, so a missing or unwritable current chat directory no longer crashes logger initialization during startup. File logging is kept best-effort while preserving the existing development (`debug/cli.jsonl`) and production (current chat directory) destinations, with the silent fallback documented in `docs(cli)`. The change adds `logger.test.ts` regression coverage for both destinations and the unavailable-chat-directory path.

1184:v2:fa59dbb2ff37.title: Disable Freebuff chat logo sheen
1184:v2:fa59dbb2ff37.summary: The PR proposes gating the animated chat-header logo sheen so that Freebuff builds keep the logo static while standard Codebuff builds retain the existing `useSheenAnimation` behavior. It introduces `shouldAnimateChatHeader` in a new `cli/src/utils/chat-header-animation.ts` module and wires it into `ChatHeader` alongside `IS_FREEBUFF`. A new `chat-header-animation.test.ts` covers the three decision paths across both products.

1183:v2:5c83e14a5266.title: Docs(cli): document account switching
1183:v2:5c83e14a5266.summary: Adds a new "Switch accounts" section to the README that explains how to switch the account used by the CLI. The docs mention the existing `/logout` and `/signout` commands and point users to the `freebuff login` browser flow after logout, including for fresh shells.

1182:v2:847760afc08b.title: Support Ctrl+Arrow word navigation in CLI input
1182:v2:847760afc08b.summary: This PR adds Ctrl+Left and Ctrl+Right word navigation to the CLI's multiline input, routing those chords (and existing Alt+Left/Right and Alt+B/F) through a shared `getWordNavigationPosition` helper. It extracts the boundary logic into a new `cli/src/utils/word-navigation.ts` module and adds regression coverage verifying Windows-style arrow chords and preserved single-character Emacs movement for Ctrl+B and Ctrl+F.

1177:v2:13bb17fd2e39.title: Synchronize terminal cursor with input caret for CJK IME support
1177:v2:13bb17fd2e39.summary: This PR proposes moving the real terminal hardware cursor to match the MultilineInput visual caret, using string-width to compute CJK cell offsets alongside tab expansion, wrapped visual lines, viewport offsets, and vertical scrolling. It centralizes OpenTUI 0.3.4 TextBufferView.lineInfo access behind a guarded adapter, keeps the line-info-change subscription stable, and hides the hardware cursor when the input loses focus or unmounts while preserving the existing visual cursor behavior. The approach is validated with regression tests covering ASCII, CJK, mixed widths, tabs, wrapped lines, viewport and scroll offsets, and renderer-level cursor placement on wrapped rows.

1176:v2:afaa31defbf1.title: Never wipe chat history on compaction
1176:v2:afaa31defbf1.summary: The compaction path now only replaces history when a real summary is produced, keeping existing turns on empty or think-only responses and logging a warning. Summary identity moves from content matching to a `CONVERSATION_SUMMARY` tag, with a legacy full-envelope fallback for pre-tag summaries. Regression tests cover both the empty response and the quoting user message cases.

1174:v2:825474ddcee2.title: Recover mid-stream 5xx/429 like severed connections
1174:v2:825474ddcee2.summary: The PR extends classifyThrownStreamRecovery so that provider-reported 500/429 arriving mid-stream via the openai-compatible shim take the same capped retry path as a severed body, injecting a status-naming note instead of ending the run. Client errors (400/401/402/403) stay fatal, and post-cancel 5xx stays fatal, with regression tests added in sdk/src/__tests__/stream-interruption.test.ts. This flips the previous logic where socket-level errors were recoverable and provider failures were fatal.

1175:v2:7d3ddfdc5da9.title: Fix(sdk): take max of OpenRouter cost and upstream inference cost
1175:v2:7d3ddfdc5da9.summary: The PR switches all three cost-reporting sites in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` (streaming `reportCost`, `generateText`, and structured paths) to take the max of `usage.cost` and `cost_details.upstream_inference_cost` instead of summing them, preventing double-counted credits on normal OpenRouter routes and correctly handling BYOK routes where cost is zero. It adds a regression test asserting exact credits for `cost=0.01, upstream=0.02` (failing under the sum with 3 vs 2) and validates with `bun test` and `tsc --noEmit`.

1221:v2:13b2ee093f12.title: Cache hidden directory checks in code search
1221:v2:13b2ee093f12.summary: The PR proposes a bounded in-memory cache with a 1-second burst TTL to de-duplicate repeated `fs.statSync` calls on blessed hidden directories (`.agents`, `.claude`, `.github`, `.gitlab`, `.circleci`, `.husky`) inside `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts`. The cache uses true LRU eviction capped at 100 entries and supports targeted invalidation via `clearHiddenDirsCache(dir?)` so cross-turn filesystem changes remain visible. Tests in `sdk/src/__tests__/code-search.test.ts` verify cache shielding within TTL, immediate discovery after manual cache clear, and LRU eviction behavior.

1234:v2:8923546885c4.title: Switch to type-safe NaN check in log ingestion utility
1234:v2:8923546885c4.summary: This PR updates the log ingestion utility to use `Number.isNaN` instead of the global `isNaN` function for timestamp validation. The global `isNaN` coerces values to numbers first, which can cause false positives, while `Number.isNaN` only matches actual NaN values of the number type. The change improves type safety in `common/src/util/log-ingest.ts`.

1230:v2:089491a8ac9b.title: Validate data URL header in summarize data URL function
1230:v2:089491a8ac9b.summary: The `summarizeDataUrl` function in `common/src/util/cache-debug.ts` now checks that the URL header starts with `data:` before extracting the media type, returning `'unknown'` when the prefix is missing. This prevents incorrect results when malformed data URLs are passed, instead of blindly slicing the first five characters.

1231:v2:610e4b63430e.title: Fix string escaping for HTML-unsafe characters to prevent XSS
1231:v2:610e4b63430e.summary: The pull request proposes updating the `escapeString` function in `common/src/util/string.ts` so it explicitly escapes HTML-unsafe characters such as `<`, `>`, `&`, and `'` into their respective unicode escape sequences. The current implementation uses `JSON.stringify` alone, which escapes quotes and backslashes but leaves HTML-injection vectors open when the result is rendered in HTML or XML contexts.

1220:v2:b8d78a81080a.title: Bound last-N visual lines memory growth
1220:v2:b8d78a81080a.summary: The terminal text helper that gathers the final n visual lines now drops the oldest line as soon as the buffer fills, marking `hasMore = true`, instead of keeping every wrapped line and slicing afterward. This keeps memory for long reasoning blocks, assistant messages, and terminal logs strictly bounded to O(n) with no extra allocation. Unit tests cover empty inputs, small counts, wrapping edges, and multi-hundred line buffers.

1213:v2:4d2c25047968.title: Support relative and absolute path keys in file windows lookup
1213:v2:4d2c25047968.summary: The file windows lookup in `getFiles` now checks `filePath`, `relativePath`, and `fullPath` instead of only `filePath`. This prevents the lookup from returning `undefined` when the requested path format differs from the key format, which previously caused the whole file to be dumped from line 1. Regression tests cover dot-slash, relative, and absolute path combinations.

1214:v2:9b9b116794df.title: Speed up CLI path completion by skipping stat calls and matching prefix first
1214:v2:9b9b116794df.summary: The PR rewrites getPathCompletion in the CLI to call readdirSync with { withFileTypes: true } and moves the prefix match check before any filesystem stat calls, so most tab completions require zero statSync syscalls. It only falls back to statSync when a matched entry is a symbolic link that needs directory resolution, cutting completion latency roughly 6.2x in a 2,500 file directory. A new regression test confirms symlinked directories still resolve and complete correctly.

1200:v2:271a643a3f66.title: Add missing CLI dev dependencies for typechecking
1200:v2:271a643a3f66.summary: The PR adds @types/react-dom, tar, and @types/tar to the cli package.json devDependencies to resolve 10 TypeScript compilation errors that occur when running typecheck or tests against the CLI package. These additions align the cli package with the root package.json React 19 overrides and match the dependencies already declared in cli/release/package.json for the tar module.

1196:v2:78806bfb7643.title: Explain why the file reader blocks files matched by ignore rules
1196:v2:78806bfb7643.summary: The file reader tool returns a bare sentinel value for files excluded by ignore rules such as gitignore, codebuffignore, or built-in defaults, leaving the agent unable to tell the user why a file is unreadable or even confirm its existence. This change appends a trailing reason and remediation hint to the existing sentinel prefix on the ignore-rule block path, following the existing too-large precedent, while keeping the environment-policy and internal-edit paths opaque for secrets.

1188:v2:41ee4824f5e8.title: Prevent directory listing escapes in the SDK
1188:v2:41ee4824f5e8.summary: The `listDirectory` tool now normalizes the project root and resolves both the requested path and project root via `realpath` before reading, reusing the shared `isPathInside` helper to reject parent traversal, sibling-prefix paths, and symlink escapes. It also pins the directory's `stat` identity before and after the `readdir` call so a path swapped out mid-read is detected and refused. The filesystem abstraction and mock gain a `realpath` implementation and regression tests cover the project root, valid children, traversal, sibling-prefix, and symlink cases.

1385:v2:e1b5bc9bcd4c.title: Add opt-in Everest compression for FreeBuff terminal output
1385:v2:e1b5bc9bcd4c.summary: This PR introduces a `/everest on|off|status` slash command that stores an `everestCompression` boolean in the CLI's `settings.json`, defaulting to off. When enabled for Freebuff runs, completed terminal stdout and stderr are sent to the locally installed Everest CLI over a correlated JSON-line bridge before the agent reads the result, while the SDK executor, broker, permissions, cancellation, exit status, and non-output fields remain unchanged. The bridge fails open on missing Everest, malformed replies, timeouts, and cancellation, short, raw, failed, and interrupted results bypass compression, and model choice, admission, quotas, and ads are untouched.
